name: A11Y Project Checklist
description: Allows the documentation of accessibility best practices using A11Y standards.
project_description: A11Y Project Checklist ports the volunteer-maintained A11Y Project accessibility checklist into Drupal as a Checklist API checklist. It defines a checklist at /admin/config/development/a11y-project-checklist whose items are fetched at build time from the A11Y Project's public checklists.json data file, each carrying a title, description, WCAG success-criterion reference and a link to more guidance. Because it builds on the Checklist API module, the date, time and username of whoever checks and saves each item are recorded to the database and can be exported to configuration, so an accessibility review can be repeated and audited over time. The module ships only item definitions, a form template override, and a Tour; access is governed by Checklist API's own permission on the admin config path.
